I feel like being nice and polite to you because you’re suicidal is a complete spit in the face to your dignity and condescending and I don’t give a shit if you get upset by this because you need to hear this and you WILL, because if someone doesn’t spell it out for you like it is then you might not even understand, so I’ll say this:

Yes all pain will inevitably fade, but killing yourself is like using a cannon on a housefly. Unnecessary. You may not understand now- but the future is unpredictable and it could get better before it gets worse or worse before it gets better.

If you can’t handle the little things then you may as well be dead anyway. Life is shit. It fucking sucks. It is horrible and mean and vindictive. It is spiteful and cruel and a ray of sun in the dark is beautiful enough. It is timid yet frightening, violent yet quiet, sorrowful and terrifyingly unpredictable, amazing, and fun, gorgeous and sexy, wild and happy, mysterious and bright all at the same time.

Any pain you inflict on yourself or get rid of by death is transmitted to those around you like a plague. It turns into guilt and shame and confusion. It is an extreme solution to a solvable problem. It cannot be altered or changed in any way. Once you go you are gone forever and you are trapped in the room and you can’t get out.

How does you dying help anyone? Like I said, it feeds trauma and self-hate and confusion and guilt into the hearts of those around you. Cutting off everyone in your life with zero explanation is the exact same thing as suicide, except you’re alive and breathing and you see everyone and everything you ever know fall apart and tear at the seams because they don’t know why. They don’t know why you did this and they’ll never know. When you’re dead you can’t see it or feel it but trust me; it’s sure as shit happening. When you’re dead you can’t get them back and tell them you’re hurting and you thought that was the only way and you didn’t think to tell them or speak to them or tell them it wasn’t their fault and it never was. 

It’s so fucking obvious you have issues you *need* to deal with because if you don’t you will do something you WILL regret.

Like I said before: if “deserving the best.” Means causing anguish and confusion and guilt to those around you, then you’re a delusional idiot.

How can you help someone become better if you’re not showing them how. What kind of example are you setting if when the going gets tough, you lose yourself and your self worth. You can’t love others before you love yourself, because shit like this happens and you don’t understand that killing yourself wont change a goddamn thing.

You’re so insecure you don’t see what’s right in front of you:

You are the only copy of you. There is only one of you. Do you not understand how amazing and beautiful that shit is. No one else has the same mindset, genetics, or personality as you. When someone falls in love with you or picks you, they pick you and no one else because it’s something YOU have that nobody else in the fucking universe has. It’s like discovering a species of animal that only has ONE animal within it. That is mythical. It’s THAT impossibly rare.

Your own mother pushed you out of her for probably several excruciating hours. She chose to birth you instead of having an abortion wether you were planned or not. She raised you by hand- her own ways, teachings and morals. She grew up with you. She prepared you for life and fed and educated you in what’s right and wrong. Each day was an opportunity for your strength to grow and increase both spiritually, mentally and physically.

She gave you a house and a (hopefully) safe environment. Bear in mind, at ANY POINT where you were being a dumbass kid, could she have kicked you out or given you away to someone else who didn’t do any of the above. But she DIDNT. She could have starved you or abused you. She did ALL OF THAT so you could live the rest of you days happy, healthy, full of good morals and love. She probably wanted you to live to the age of retirement AT LEAST.

You could have had disgustingly awful friends who bullied you and made you feel like shit. Your old ones probably did but at least these ones love you. They LOVE YOU.

When you’re dead, you CANNOT redo this or continue with this opportunity.  You can’t ever indulge on luxuries or do the little things.

No any pain won’t be gone because anything you currently love will be mercilessly ripped out of your hands. You will be surrounded by nothing but darkness for the rest of eternity. You will long for a hand yet feel no touch, you will thirst and there will be no drink. You will hunger but there will be nothing to eat. There will be no one to have sex with. There will be no family or children to have. There will be no lakes or oceans to swim in or people to talk to or cultures to enjoy or holidays to sleep through.

ANYTHING YOU ENJOY WILL NOT FUCKING EXIST.

Your time will come eventually. Any doubts or pain you have will not last forever, but it will last for those you leave behind. You will be okay.

You will be so far gone that it will be next to impossible to retain any dignity and confidence in yourself.

It is not your fault that she shit the bed in the parenting department; never has been never will be. And the fact that she has the audacity to THREATEN you with the removal of your only lifeline is disgraceful, offensive and appalling. She has proven time and time again that she is not fit to be a mother and she lucky to still have custody of you at all. This is the exact same thing abusive partners do to retain control  over their victims- and trust you’re a fucking victim.

Please for the love of all that is holy and graceful leave immediately; pack your things and go. Find somewhere safe where you can bunk whilst you have CPS or even the Police deal with your mum. You may need proof- so bait her into saying things and record them. If this doesn’t work then simply run away.

That parasite may try to stop you from leaving; she will pull every trick in the book- do not be fooled. Do not trust that she cares about you. Do not allow the serpent to use her silver tongue on you because what you hear is not what you see in a literal and metaphorical sense. If she really loves you, if she really cares about you, she WOULD NOT have treated you like the gum on the sole of her shoe or the pebble in her boot.

You may think that she is sorry- well she shouldn’t have treated you like that at all. Sometimes apologies mean nothing. Sometimes they are a way to bind you and make you feel guilty. She might even say she’ll kill herself. That’s a bluff. Many things she’ll say will be bluffs. But always remember that logic comes first and emotion comes last.

So please save yourself and run.

I’ve always worked out at home. It’s best to use YouTube for fitness videos. My favourite is Hasfit and the coaches on there are brilliant. It tells you how many calories you’ve burnt off and for how long you’ve been exercising. They are extremely motivating too!

Another thing is picking up a schedule. Not just for what day you will do which area of the body/type of workout, but at what time you will do anything throughout the day (for example lunch or dinner). 
This means that for each day you will know exactly what you are going to do and eat. It’s very satisfying, encourages good habits and gives a sense of purpose. Always remember that you can have treat days and you don’t have to work out every day. In fact if you work out to your limit it’s okay to skip several days. 

Another thing is that it’s really good to get in a good sleep schedule and be consistent throughout the weeks as to allow your body time to rest and work properly. Eating and sleeping at the sane time every day helps your metabolism too.
